title: Bees Understand Zero With Fewer Than a Million Neurons

scenes.text: Bees understand zero, with under a million neurons.
Zero took humans centuries to grasp.
Researchers trained honeybees to pick the picture with fewer shapes for sugar water.
Three beat four. Two beat three.
Then came a blank picture against one with a single shape. The bees picked the blank one.
A human brain has about 86 billion neurons. The bee's has under one million.

description:
Bees understand zero, with under a million neurons.
A 2018 study in Science trained honeybees to pick the image with fewer elements. When shown an empty image, they treated it as the lowest number, even though they had never been trained on it.
What other animal do you think understands zero? Comment below.
first_comment: Monkeys, birds and now bees. Which animal would you test next?
